name: Magic Copy for Elementor – Cross Domain Copy Paste
author: Mustafa Kamal hossain

sections.description:
Magic Copy for Elementor is the ultimate cross-domain and cross-site copy paste productivity tool built for web designers, agencies, and WordPress developers. It enables instant live copy from frontend pages directly into any Elementor container or layout canvas.

  • Cross-Site & Cross-Domain Copy Paste: Copy any Elementor container, section, grid, or widget directly from a live site and perform a cross-site transfer to paste on completely separate domain names without downloading JSON export files.
  • Live Copy & Native Editor Paste: Enjoy 1-click live copy capability on published pages. Simply hover over any Elementor container or widget, click to copy, and execute a copy paste action inside the Elementor editor using native keyboard shortcuts (Cmd+V / Ctrl+V).
  • Cross-Domain Layout Transfer: Move complex Elementor container structures, multi-column sections, and nested templates with automatic media sideloading into the destination WordPress Media Library.

Whether you’re managing client websites, replicating agency design frameworks, or performing a cross-domain site migration, Magic Copy delivers effortless cross-site copy paste capabilities for every Elementor container and layout.

🟢 FREE FEATURES (Included Out of the Box)

  • Cross-Site & Cross-Domain Transfer: Move any Elementor container or section from Site A to Site B across separate domain names.
  • Live Copy Hover Overlay: Perform a live copy directly from published pages without opening the editor interface.
  • Native Keyboard Copy Paste: Paste copied layouts directly into any Elementor container using standard Cmd+V / Ctrl+V commands.
  • Smart Asset & Media Sideloading: Automatically sideloads image assets into the target site’s WordPress Media Library during a cross-site import.
  • Deep Style & Settings Preservation: Preserves all padding, typography, custom CSS rules, and responsive parameters during a cross-domain copy paste operation.
  • Child Element Include/Exclude: Easily toggle whether child widgets within containers are included in your copy paste workflow.
  • Elementor 4.x Compatible: Fully supports modern Flexbox Containers, CSS Grid, and Atomic Elements architecture.

🟡 PROFESSIONAL PLAN FEATURES

  • Personal Cloud Library: Save your favorite Elementor containers and widgets to your personal cloud account and insert them on any site with 1-click inside the Elementor editor.
  • Copy History Snapshots (Last 50 Elements): Automatically record your last 50 copied elements with 1-click restore, search filter, and element type badges.
  • Global Copy Rules: Define site-wide copy rules by element type (container, section, widget), CSS class (.copyable), or wildcard selectors to auto-enable copy.
  • Granular Role & User Access Controls: Configure per-role capability permissions across WP roles and Logged-Out Guests, with User ID Whitelist and Blacklist.
  • Shareable Template Links: Generate public or password-protected token URLs to share Elementor components with clients or community.

🔴 BUSINESS PLAN FEATURES

  • Team Cloud Clipboard (Shared Team Library): Shared cloud library workspace allowing entire agency teams and freelancers to build, invite team members, and share a centralized component library.
  • Cross-Site Direct Push: Send Elementor elements directly from Site A to Site B via secure REST API without manual copy paste.
  • White-Label Branding: Rebrand plugin display name in WP Admin menu, customize hover copy button text & colors, and suppress Manfii branding notices.
  • WooCommerce Builder Support: Smart detection and mapping for WooCommerce product widgets and category references.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the magic-copy-for-elementor folder to /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly via WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Open any live page containing Elementor elements, hover over an element, and click the Magic Copy button.
  4. Open the Elementor editor on any destination site and paste using Cmd+V or Ctrl+V.
sections.faq:
Does Magic Copy work with Elementor Flexbox Containers?

Yes! Magic Copy fully supports modern Flexbox Containers, CSS Grid, columns, sections, and individual widgets.

Do images transfer automatically when performing a cross-domain copy paste?

Yes! External and local image URLs embedded in element settings are automatically sideloaded into the destination site’s WordPress Media Library during a cross-domain copy paste import.

Does Magic Copy require both sites to have the plugin installed?

To perform a live copy from a live site, Magic Copy (Free or Pro) must be active on that site. To paste into the Elementor editor, Magic Copy must be active on the target site.

1.1.4

  • Feature: Added Copy History Snapshots (last 50 elements) with 1-click restore/paste, search filter, element type badges, and clear history.
  • Feature: Added Global Copy Rules for site-wide automatic copy overlays by element type (container, section, widget), CSS class (.copyable), or wildcard selector.
  • Feature: Added Granular Role & User Access Controls with per-role capability matrix across WP roles and Logged-Out Guests, plus User ID Whitelist and Blacklist.
  • Feature: Added Team Cloud Clipboard (Shared Team Library) for agency team member invitations, team roster management, and shared layout pasting (Business Plan).
  • Feature: Added White-Label Branding allowing custom plugin display name, custom hover copy button text, custom button background/text colors, and Manfii branding suppression (Business Plan).
  • Security: Resolved PHPCS WordPress Coding Standards compliance and sanitization rules.

1.1.3

  • Fix: Security patch updated.
  • Update: Updated UX.
  • Compatibility: Checked feature compatibility with latest Elementor.

1.1.2

  • Feature: Added Cross-Site Direct Push for transferring Elementor layouts directly from Site A to Site B via secure REST API (POST /wp-json/magiccopyel-pro/v1/push) with secret key authentication.
  • Feature: Added target remote page selector for appending pushed elements directly to existing Elementor pages.
  • Feature: Added automatic remote media sideloading on receiving site during Cross-Site Push.
  • Feature: Added Cross-Site Push admin management UI for registering connected sites and secret key generation.
  • Feature: Added Elementor editor Cross-Site Direct Push modal interface.
  • Compatibility: Updated and verified compatibility with Elementor 4.2.1 and Elementor Pro 4.2.1.

1.1.1

  • Feature: Added Shareable Template Links for generating tokenized URLs with optional password protection and custom expiration rules (1 Day, 7 Days, 30 Days, Never).
  • Feature: Added 1-Click Share Link Import tab in Elementor Editor modal drawer.
  • Feature: Added “+ Save Element to Cloud” action button inside Personal Cloud Library modal with automatic clipboard JSON payload detection and element type auto-classification.
  • UX: Enhanced Elementor Editor UI integration supporting Elementor 4.2.0 Atomic Elements iframe architecture (#elementor-preview-iframe).
  • UX: Added standalone inline SVG cloud download icons and custom cyan dropdown chevron styling for select controls (#mcfe-save-type, #mcfe-share-expiry).
  • UX: Redesigned Admin Welcome Dashboard (wp-admin/admin.php?page=magiccopyel-welcome) with feature spotlight grid and live System Health Status badges.
  • Fix: Implemented universal copyTextToClipboard() with document.execCommand('copy') fallback for non-HTTPS local development domains (http://*.test).
  • Fix: Resolved WordPress core emoji parser (wp-emoji-release.min.js) layout distortion on dashboard hero banner.
  • Fix: Resolved Freemius API license authentication 400 response for active Professional and Business plan licenses.

1.1.0

  • Feature: Added compatibility for Pro Personal Cloud Library integration.
  • Performance: Optimized Elementor editor asset loading routines and payload handlers.
  • Update: UX update and security patch.
  • Compatibility: Checked feature compatibility with latest Elementor.

1.0.9

  • Added: Freemius SDK integration for managing licensing and standalone Pro updates.
  • Added: Automatic database cleanup routine on plugin uninstall.
  • Updated: Unified deployment workflows for Free & Pro releases.

1.0.8

  • Update: Added modern pill-shaped copy overlay, inline loading spinners, and custom toast notification alerts.
  • Fix: Addressed PHPCS security sanitization warnings in AJAX controllers.
  • Compatibility: Updated WordPress compatibility tag to 7.0 and verified Elementor compatibility.

1.0.7

  • Fix: Security update.
  • Update: UX update.
  • Compatibility: Elementor compatibility check.
